title: 第9章 食堂里的加戏王
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
食堂二楼靠窗的位置，苏念念面前摆着一盘糖醋排骨、一碗米饭和一碟青菜。

    周小鱼的餐盘上是酸辣粉加卤蛋，安槐只拿了一碗面和一个饼。

    苏念念看了他的餐盘一眼，皱眉。

    “就吃这么点？”

    “够了。”

    “够什么够，你一米八二的大个子吃这么少像话吗？”苏念念说着，直接从自己盘里夹了两块排骨放到他的碗里，动作自然得像呼吸一样。

    安槐也没推辞，低头吃了一块。

    周小鱼在对面看着这一幕，嘴里的酸辣粉都忘了嚼。

    “念念你跟安槐真的不是……”

    “不是什么？”苏念念夹起一块排骨，咬了一口，眼神里透着一丝危险。

    周小鱼立刻改口：“不是一般的关系好！从小长大的情分就是不一样！”

    “这还差不多。”苏念念满意地收回目光。

    安槐安静吃面，眼角余光扫到斜前方两张桌子的位置。

    林落雪端着餐盘，在食堂里看了一圈，像是在找位置，她身边跟着沈晨，沈晨手里端着两个餐盘，走路都小心翼翼，生怕洒了。

    “林同学，那边有位置。”沈晨朝一个空桌努了努嘴。

    林落雪轻轻点头，走过去坐下，路过苏念念这桌的时候，她微微侧头，露出一个淡淡的微笑。

    “苏同学，你们也在这边吃啊。”

    苏念念嘴里嚼着排骨，含糊地嗯了一声，算是打了招呼。

    林落雪也没多说什么，和沈晨坐到了两张桌子之外的位置。

    安槐低头吃面，耳朵却没闲着。

    林落雪和沈晨的对话断断续续地传过来，大部分是沈晨在说，林落雪在听。

    “这个红烧鸡腿是食堂的招牌，你尝尝。”

    “我吃不了这么多……”

    “那我帮你吃。”

    “沈晨同学你人真好。”

    标准的奶狗和小白花剧本，沈晨浑然不知自己正在被编排进一出量身定做的戏里。

    【检测到“沈晨”好感度变化：对“林落雪”的好感度从“初始好感”上升至“好感偏高”。按照这个速度，大概两周后会进入“我愿意为她做任何事”阶段，宿主，要不要提醒一下这位透明人？】

    “不用。”

    【为什么？】

    “提醒了他也不会信，一个刚认识三天的人说'那个女生在算计你'，正常人都会觉得你有病。”

    【那你打算怎么办？】

    “等，等到他自己看清楚，或者等到事情发展到能摆证据的时候，现在说什么都是空口白话。”

    【行，你是理科生你有道理，不过我提醒你一句，原著里沈晨在看清林落雪之前，已经帮她做了不少事了，其中包括针对苏念念的那些。】

    安槐吃面的动作没停，但手指在筷子上微微用力了一下。

    “那就看谁更快。”

    苏念念完全不知道旁边这位小弟正在心里进行高强度的情报分析，她把最后一块排骨塞进嘴里，满足地叹了口气。
content_en:
On the second floor of the cafeteria, by the window, a plate of sweet and sour pork ribs, a bowl of rice and a plate of vegetables were placed in front of Su Niannian.

Zhou Xiaoyu's plate contained hot and sour noodles and braised eggs, while An Huai only had a bowl of noodles and a pancake.

Su Niannian glanced at his dinner plate and frowned.

"Just eat this much?"

"That's enough."

"What's enough? Can you, a tall man of 1.82 meters, eat so little?" Su Niannian said, taking two pieces of ribs from her plate and putting them into his bowl, her movements as natural as breathing.

An Huai didn't refuse, lowered his head and ate a piece.

Zhou Xiaoyu watched this scene from the opposite side, forgetting to chew the hot and sour noodles in his mouth.

"Nian Nian, you and An Huai are really not..."

"It's not what?" Su Niannian picked up a piece of ribs and took a bite, with a hint of danger in her eyes.

Zhou Xiaoyu immediately changed his mind: "It's not an ordinary good relationship! The relationship we grew up with is different!"

"That's pretty much it." Su Niannian looked back with satisfaction.

An Huai ate the noodles quietly and glanced at the two tables diagonally in front of him from the corner of his eye.

Lin Luoxue held the dinner plate and looked around the cafeteria, as if looking for a seat. Shen Chen was followed by her side. Shen Chen held two dinner plates in his hands and walked carefully for fear of spilling them.

"Classmate Lin, there's a seat over there." Shen Chen pursed his lips towards an empty table.

Lin Luoxue nodded lightly, walked over and sat down. When passing Su Niannian's table, she turned her head slightly and showed a faint smile.

"Student Su, you guys are eating here too."

Su Niannian chewed the ribs and hummed vaguely as a greeting.

Lin Luoxue didn't say much, and sat two tables away from Shen Chen.

An Huai lowered his head to eat noodles, but his ears were not idle.

The conversation between Lin Luoxue and Shen Chen came intermittently, with Shen Chen talking mostly and Lin Luoxue listening.

"This braised chicken drumstick is the canteen's signature dish, try it."

"I can't eat so much..."

"Then I'll help you eat."

"Classmate Shen Chen, you are such a kind person."

It was a standard script for a milk dog and a little white flower. Shen Chen had no idea that he was being choreographed into a tailor-made drama.

[Changes in the favorability of "Chen Chen" were detected: the favorability of "Lin Luoxue" increased from "initial favorability" to "high favorability".At this rate, we will enter the "I am willing to do anything for her" stage in about two weeks. Host, do you want to remind this transparent person?】

"No need."

【Why?】

"He won't believe it even if I remind him. If someone he's only known for three days says, 'That girl is plotting against you,' a normal person would think you are sick."

[Then what are you going to do?】

"Wait, wait until he sees it clearly for himself, or wait until the matter develops to the point where evidence can be presented. Whatever he says now is just empty talk."

[Okay, you are a science student, so you have a point, but let me remind you that in the original book, before Shen Chen saw Lin Luoxue clearly, she had already done a lot of things for her, including those directed at Su Niannian.】

An Huai didn't stop eating the noodles, but his fingers pressed slightly on the chopsticks.

"Then let's see who is faster."

Su Niannian had no idea that the boy next to her was conducting intense intelligence analysis in her mind. She stuffed the last piece of ribs into her mouth and sighed with satisfaction.
title_en: Chapter 9 The extravaganza king in the cafeteria
